responsibility: Provides the GNU/Linux subtarget configuration header for the CRIS backend. It overrides the generic CRIS and GNU/Linux target macros to set Linux-specific driver, preprocessor, cc1, assembler, and linker specs; selects the default CRIS architecture variant for Linux builds; defines built-in preprocessor symbols such as the default __arch_v10/__arch_v32 and underscore-related macros; fixes ABI-visible type macros like size_t and ptrdiff_t; and adjusts startup/runtime details such as the dynamic linker path and disabling the generic CRIS static-constructor CRT helper in favor of the Linux crt files.
same_name_distinction: Header-side Linux subtarget definition file: it sets CRIS-on-GNU/Linux target macros and specs used by preprocessing, cc1, assembler, linker, builtins, ABI type definitions, and runtime startup defaults. Unlike linux.opt, it does not declare command-line options; it hardwires the target configuration that those options operate within.
